name: Single-leg calf raise
summary: A calf raise on one leg — the standard for Achilles and ankle rehab.
setup: Stand on one leg side-on to the phone, working leg nearest, fingertips on a wall. Rise onto the ball of the foot, pause, lower over three seconds. Keep the knee straight and the ankle from rolling out.
brief: Stand on one leg with the fingertips on a wall. Rise onto the ball of the foot, pause, then lower over three seconds.
why: The ankle angle counts each rise from the side; the knee bending shows as the leg angle closing.
tempo: Up 2 s, hold 1 s, down 3 s.
progression: Heel off a step; hold a weight.
contraindications: Achilles pain above a mild ache.

faults.label: Knee bending to help
faults.tip: Keep the knee locked; the rise comes from the ankle alone.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Ankle rolling outward
faults.tip: Drive through the big toe joint so the heel rises straight up.

faults.label: Not reaching full height
faults.cue: All the way up on your toes
faults.tip: Full height every rep; when you cannot, the set is finished.

faults.label: Dropping the heel
faults.tip: Control on the way down is the part that rebuilds an Achilles tendon.

guide.stop: Achilles pain, or the ankle rolling painfully.

points.t: Full rise, slow lower, heel tracking straight up.
